purpose: Diagnose provider/project/model visibility after repeated 503 generation failures without making a model inference request.

interpretation.both_200: API key/project can resolve both model resources; repeated generation 503s are more consistent with generation-service capacity/routing than missing model visibility.
interpretation.403: Investigate API key/project permissions, API access, or account/project configuration before another runtime attempt.
interpretation.404: Investigate exact model availability/visibility for this project before another runtime attempt.
interpretation.429: Investigate project rate/quota limits before another runtime attempt.
interpretation.5xx: Treat as broader provider/service availability evidence; do not buy another behavioral canary immediately.
